theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_bh_blowUp_domain_boundary
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (x : Euclid P), IsOpen U → x ∈ U → x ∉ boundarySupport T → ∀ (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ j, 0 < lams j), Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ j, IsOpen (dilation x (lams j) '' U)) ∧ (∀ R : ℝ, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R ⊆ dilation x (lams j) '' U) ∧ (∀ R : ℝ, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ∀ ω : TestFormOn (dilation x (lams j) '' U) m, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ ball 0 R → (blowUp T x (lams j) (hlams j).ne').boundary ω = 0)
